title: Embers amol yaaben xagana
intro: Atu bacaar girah xaqut solta tet girah cubbil baxacta wak. Gufneh yemeete mari sabhalal le angaarawih addat geytimaah, inki farmo xagana, assakat kee fooca fan uxih kibbiime wayte xaagu fakka hayta.
clues: Nanu bacari addat tan amanti le taama abeynit gufnuh baxxo taturre.
Nanu gira massoosuh embers baxcisaanam esserne.
Nanu xabcaa kee amaanah girah seeco abe numu lih yabne.
Nanu xaagu baahenno qusba yooboke numuk teynay xaylo xalaanamih karmak taturte.
Nanu xagana cule alqi Isxaaq migaq hayneh.
Nanu Ibraahiimih baxi rufto le xaagu bahneeh, assakat le xaagi Ibraahiimih asaaluk cabe.
